customManagers.description: Container image pins in lib/00_constants.sh. No packaging manifest exists in this repo, so the constants file is the manifest; the regex must stay in step with the `readonly NAME_IMAGE="registry/repo:tag@sha256:..."` shape that scripts/pin-digests.sh also parses.

packageRules.description: Keep actions on a commit SHA with the tag in a trailing comment, which is how they are pinned today.
Digest-only rebuilds of an unchanged tag are what scripts/pin-digests.sh --check already catches weekly; grouping them keeps that noise to one PR.
Synapse config keys and its PostgreSQL floor have both changed inside the 1.x line, and neither is visible to Renovate.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Read https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/blob/develop/docs/upgrade.md between the old and new version before merging. Synapse states breaking changes there, not in the release title. Check in particular for config keys `templates/configs/homeserver.synapse.yaml.tpl` sets, and for a PostgreSQL floor change (`MIN_PG_VERSION` in `lib/00_constants.sh`, asserted by `tests/test_version_floors.sh`).

packageRules.description: PostgreSQL major upgrades need a dump and restore; lib/26_upgrade.sh aborts rather than performing one.
prBodyNotes: :warning: A PostgreSQL major bump strands every existing deployment: `upgrade_check` refuses to proceed when the data directory's major differs from the image. Do not merge without a migration path.
